text: The Cantor set is constructed by removing the middle thirds from [0,1] iteratively. It is:
choices: uncountable, closed, nowhere dense, and has Lebesgue measure 0
explanation: The Cantor set: closed (complement is open), uncountable (homeomorphic to {0,1}^ℕ), nowhere dense (no interval), measure 0 (∑(2/3)^n→0). A classic pathological set.
